# staticform_user_settings (Resource)

The authenticated account's notification settings. This is a singleton — one per account. Destroying it only removes it from state; it does not reset the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email_overage_enabled` (Boolean) Allow email overage charges beyond the plan quota.
- `email_quota_warning_enabled` (Boolean) Warn at 80%/95% of the email quota.
- `storage_warning_enabled` (Boolean) Warn at 80%/90% of storage.
- `submission_overview_email_frequency` (String) Submission summary cadence: `Off`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`.
- `submit_action_failure_notification_enabled` (Boolean) Email the account when a submit action fails.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
